'''2015 MPC Steve Brentson DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Brentson]] at [[2015 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Steve Brentson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
